project_overview.description: Two TCO (The Chosen One Agency) internal benchmark dashboards built from Excel data exports.

dashboards.name: Main Client Dashboard
dashboards.description: Per-client organic + paid media analytics. Loads data from Apps Script or local data.json fallback. Has panels: Overview, Organic, Content, Summary, Paid Media.
dashboards.notes: Apps Script only returns organic/content/summary. data.json also contains paid array.

dashboards.name: Industry Benchmark Dashboard
dashboards.description: Industry-first view with hardcoded JS data objects. Shows organic MoM benchmarks and paid media by industry (F&B, Hotel, Real Estate, Other). Data: Jul 2025–Aug 2026.

data_json_structure.organic: 582 records — {month, brand, industry, platform, followers, reach, impressions, engagements, er_pct, top_organic, organic_link, organic_category, organic_type, top_boosted, boosted_link, boosted_category, boosted_type, notes}
data_json_structure.content: 480 records — {month, brand, industry, platform, type, title, link, category, post_type, engagement, reach, views, shares, saves}
data_json_structure.summary: 29 records — {industry, brand, status, period, fb_follower_growth, fb_total_reach, fb_total_eng, ig_follower_growth, ig_reach_growth, ig_eng_growth}
data_json_structure.paid: 463 records — {month, brand, industry, platform, campaign_type, spend, results, cpr, impressions, reach, cpm, ctr, leads, cpl, top_campaign}

excel_sheet_notes.organic_sheet: Brand Data (Industry) - Organic — header row 3, data from row 4. Industry label rows have no Platform value. Month and Brand forward-fill.
excel_sheet_notes.paid_sheet: Paid Media Data — title rows 1-2 skip, header row 3 skip, data from row 4. Columns: Month, Brand, Industry, Platform, Campaign Type, Spend ฿, Results, Cost per Result ฿, Impressions, Reach, CPM ฿, CTR%, Registers/Leads, CPA/CPL ฿, Top Campaign/Creative
excel_sheet_notes.er_pct_normalization: ER% raw values from Excel stored as fraction (e.g. 0.0041 = 0.41%). Normalization: if er_pct < 2, multiply by 100. In BRAND_PERF data, er is computed as engagements/reach*100.

industry_benchmark_data_objects.ORG: Monthly avg reach/engagement per industry per platform (fb/ig). Keys: fnb, hotel, restate, other. Sub-keys: fb, ig. Values: {YYYY-MM: {r, e}}. Covers Jul 2025–Aug 2026.
industry_benchmark_data_objects.BRAND_PERF: Per-brand top post data per industry per month. Keys: fnb, hotel, restate, other. Values: {YYYY-MM: {fb:[{n,f,r,e,er,cat}], ig:[...]}}. Covers Jul 2025–Aug 2026.
industry_benchmark_data_objects.TOP_BRANDS: All-time cumulative totals per brand. Array of {name, industry, fb_reach, fb_eng, ig_reach, ig_eng}.
industry_benchmark_data_objects.PAID_FNB: F&B paid media by month. {YYYY-MM: [{brand, obj, result, cpr, spend, cpm}]}. Brands: Hanare, PolaPola, SōL Phuket, HEH.
industry_benchmark_data_objects.PAID_HOTEL: Hotel paid media. Brand: Sheraton Grande Sukhumvit. {YYYY-MM: [{brand, obj, spend, reach, cpm}]}.
industry_benchmark_data_objects.PAID_RE: Real Estate paid media. Brands: Panarah, Phetcharat Group. {YYYY-MM: [{brand, obj, spend, reach, cpm}]}.
industry_benchmark_data_objects.PAID_ECOMM: E-commerce paid (Jul–Sep 2025 only). Brands: Pola Pola, Banpong.

apps_script_update.description: Code.gs currently only returns organic/content/summary — does NOT include paid data. To add paid: extend doGet() to also read and return paid array from TCO__Paid_Media_Tracking_Sheet.

key_technical_notes: Chart.js version 4.4.1 used for Paid Media panel charts in index.html
openpyxl used with read_only=True, data_only=True to parse Excel files
ER% in BRAND_PERF is always computed as: engagements / reach * 100 (not from Excel ER column)
industry values are uppercase: FNB, HOTEL, RESTATE, OTHER (in organic/content/summary data)
Apps Script forward-fills Month, Brand, Industry when blank rows appear
